request: Push the fountain closer to the supplied detailed target after another close visual comparison.
route: deterministic img2threejs geometry refinement followed by source GLB export, Blender MCP optimization, optimized GLB re-import, and Unity prefab rebuild
userDecision: revision-requested because planar seam-strip endpoints floated beyond curved stone surfaces
changes: reduced the lower rim volume and increased the readable lower water area
replaced the roof-like pedestal cap with a compact two-stage octagonal cap
reprofiled the upper bowl into a smaller and shallower tier
reduced the upper copper collar and rebuilt the finial as a shorter grooved acorn
resculpted all four fish spouts with narrower necks, tapered heads, compact circular mouths, subtle side-set eyes, gill plates, fins, crests, and a slight downward aim
kept four pale curved streams with paired impact ripples and splash stems aligned to the new mouth positions
changed the visible stone-joint treatment from blue-green to a restrained warm shadow line while retaining the five-material and eight-draw-call budgets

limitations: The fish ornaments remain deterministic procedural geometry rather than hand-sculpted organic meshes.
Stone joints remain thin flush geometry rather than destructive mortar cuts.

Android device performance and final in-game art-direction approval remain pending.
